prompts.neutral-base-body-20261005: Edit the reference into ONE intact base-body sprite for a very simple layered character system. Keep the full SD character in exactly the same pose, three-quarter right view, position, size, pixel-art style, outline, warm skin colors, ears, nose, tiny neutral mouth, neck, gray tank top, charcoal shorts, hands and bare feet. Exactly TWO arms and TWO legs. Remove only all scalp hair and BOTH eyes and eyebrows; restore a complete smooth bald skull and uninterrupted blank skin where the eyes/brows were. The head, cheek, jaw and neck must be one complete closed opaque character shape, with no missing patches or holes. The skull should fit underneath the original hairstyle. Do not split, rearrange, recolor or restyle any body parts. Do not create an atlas or multiple pieces. Return the single whole base character, in the original square framing and truly transparent background, with the same clear margin around it.
prompts.original-hair-overlay-20261005: Extract a single reusable HAIR overlay sprite from the reference character. Keep only the exact short spiky brown hairstyle, its pixel clusters, highlights, outline, fringe and side hair. Keep its original shape, view, and apparent size relative to the reference; preserve the existing accepted hairstyle rather than inventing a new haircut. Remove the entire face, eyes, eyebrows, ears, neck, body, hands, legs, clothes and feet. No skin pixels, no face patches, no new head. Leave the inside head opening transparent so this one hair image can be placed on top of a bald base sprite. Show one complete hair cap, no separate front/back pieces or atlas. Truly transparent background. Preserve generous margins and the original square framing; the isolated cap occupies the original head/hair location.
prompts.simple-eyes-overlay-20261005: Create ONE eye-and-eyebrow overlay for the bald SD base in image 1, using the exact accepted eyes from image 2 as the art reference. Only the TWO eyes and TWO eyebrows: large near brown eye on the left, narrow far eye on the right, white eye shapes, brown irises, dark pixel outlines and the original thick eyebrows. Three-quarter right-facing view, exactly the accepted pixel style. No head, hair, face, ears, nose, mouth, skin patch or body. Everything between and around the eye/brow shapes is transparent. This is one paired-eye sprite that will be placed on the intact base body as a layer. Do not create a sprite sheet or add more eyes. Keep generous empty margins.
prompts.simple-shirt-overlay-20261005: Create ONE clothing overlay for image 1. Keep its original apparent width/height and position relative to the reference. Keep ONLY the tank-top clothing image. No skin, no neck, head, hair, eyes, body, arms, hands, shorts, legs or feet. No sleeves, jacket, buckles, patterns or extra equipment. One simple teal tank top, on a truly transparent background with generous margins, to place as a layer directly over the gray tank top of the intact base sprite. Do not create an atlas or dismembered body.
